item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Padding audits now pass, so prioritize identifying when older context helps or harms. Seek paired probes that hold recent suffixes, targets, candidates and supervision fixed while varying older context. Measure target-rank changes and harmful versus helpful context by history length; connect these effects to GRU gate saturation and gradient decay without treating perturbations as causal evidence of user intent.","query":"GRU4Rec recurrent sequential recommendation history attribution matched prefix interventions context truncation GRU gate saturation gradient decay diagnostic faithfulness 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Translate qualitative complaints into auditable recommendation-level evidence. Seek protocols that distinguish recent-specific relevance, broad relatedness, possible functional redundancy and insufficient information using permitted titles, descriptions and histories. Calibrate automated proxies against explicit feedback from the twenty users, report agreement and abstentions, and avoid inferring ownership, compatibility or latent traits from interactions alone.","query":"recommendation diagnostic evaluation user feedback taxonomy recent intent broad semantic relevance functional redundancy evidence grounded item descriptions annotation agreement abstention 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Replace reliance on single-negative training margins with a diagnostic ranking panel using training-history replay targets, fixed unique candidate pools and chunked full-catalog scoring. Investigate whether failures reflect negative difficulty, item popularity, score norms or representation geometry. Seek user-level uncertainty estimates and falsification controls, then assess whether predefined diagnostic changes track host validation HR@10 across separate single-model conditions without modifying the evaluator.","query":"sequential recommendation sampled ranking evaluation full catalog discrepancy hard negatives popularity embedding anisotropy diagnostic validity user bootstrap negative controls 2024 2025 2026"}]}
